nodes.description: Privileged owner address set in the constructor; gate for delegate, init, setTradeAddress, batchSend and the mint path.
Public mapping of token balances, mutated by transferFrom, _mints, batchSend and the constructor without SafeMath protection.
Public nested mapping of spending allowances written by approve, transferFrom and the constructor.
Whitelisted trade address readable by ensure and writable only by the owner through setTradeAddress.
Private per-address sale counter incremented in transferFrom and read by condition.
Private whitelist mapping consulted by ensure and set by _mints.
Private maximum number of sales per address; configured by init and read by condition.
Private minimum transfer amount; configured by init and read by condition.
Private maximum transfer amount; configured by init and read by condition.
Public total supply, assigned in the constructor.
Immutable Uniswap V2 router constant address that ensure compares against.
Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom with msg.sender as the source.
Public payable transferFrom that spends allowance, enforces ensure(), and mutates balances and _onSaleNum.
Internal whitelist gate that derives a pair address via pairFor and calls condition for non-whitelisted senders.
Public payable approve that writes allowance for msg.sender.
Internal view checking _saleNum, _minSale, _maxSale and _onSaleNum constraints.
Owner-restricted function performing an arbitrary delegatecall on a user supplied address.
Owner or hardcoded-address restricted mint that overwrites balanceOf and whitelists the recipient.
Owner-only configuration of sale limits _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum.
Owner-only batch distribution; computes total = _value * _tos.length and loops over recipients.
Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
Internal pure Uniswap pair address derivation used by ensure.
Payable constructor initializing name, symbol, totalSupply, owner, balances and router allowance.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization checks, ownership and as transfer source.
Low-level delegatecall to an arbitrary address supplied by the caller, executed in the storage context of UniswapExchange.
Unchecked multiplication total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend, able to overflow uint256 and bypass the balance check.
Source address parameter of transferFrom and ensure.
Recipient address parameter of transfer and transferFrom.
Amount parameter of transfer, transferFrom and ensure/condition checks.
Spender address parameter of approve.
Target address parameter of the delegate delegatecall.
Calldata bytes parameter of the delegate delegatecall.
Recipient address parameter of _mints.
Mint amount parameter of _mints, scaled by 10**decimals.
saleNum parameter assigned to _saleNum in init.
minSale token amount parameter of init.
maxSale token amount parameter of init.
Array of recipient addresses in batchSend.
Per-recipient amount parameter of batchSend, multiplied by array length.
New trade address parameter of setTradeAddress.
Initial supply parameter of the constructor.
Local total = _value * _tos.length subject to integer overflow.
Loop index of the batchSend distribution loop.
Local _UNI pair address derived by pairFor inside ensure.

edges.reason: transfer passes msg.sender as the _from argument into transferFrom.
transfer unconditionally invokes transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender for the allowance check.
transferFrom requires ensure(_from, _to, _value) before mutating balances.
ensure calls condition for non-whitelisted senders.
transferFrom subtracts from and adds to balanceOf entries.
transferFrom reads and decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender].
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] after each transfer.
condition compares _onSaleNum[_from] against _saleNum.
condition reads _saleNum to enforce per-address sale count.
condition reads _minSale to enforce the minimum transfer amount.
condition reads _maxSale to enforce the maximum transfer amount.
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
_mints authorizes msg.sender against owner or a hardcoded address before minting.
_mints overwrites balanceOf[spender] with the scaled addedValue.
_mints sets canSale[spender] = true, whitelisting the recipient.
init requires msg.sender == owner before changing sale parameters.
init assigns _minSale from the token parameter.
init assigns _maxSale from the maxToken parameter.
init assigns _saleNum.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner before distributing balances.
batchSend decrements the owner balance and credits each recipient balanceOf.
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length without SafeMath, allowing multiplication overflow.
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner.
setTradeAddress writes the tradeAddress whitelist state variable.
delegate requires msg.sender == owner before executing arbitrary code.
delegate performs a delegatecall on the caller-supplied address a with calldata b.
The delegatecall executes foreign code in the contract storage context where owner is stored, enabling privileged state manipulation.
The constructor sets owner = msg.sender.
Constructor writes the owner state variable.
Constructor assigns totalSupply from the supplied amount.
Constructor credits the deployer balance in balanceOf.
Constructor grants unlimited allowance to the Uniswap router.
ensure calls pairFor to derive the _UNI pair address.
ensure stores the pairFor result in the local _UNI.
ensure compares the sender against the UNI router constant.
ensure consults canSale[_from] to bypass condition.
ensure compares _from against the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
ensure compares _from and _to against owner to grant unconditional transfers.
_from identifies the debited account in transferFrom.
_to identifies the credited account in transferFrom.
_value is the amount moved and checked against balanceOf in transferFrom.
_from is evaluated against the whitelist inside ensure.
_value is compared against _minSale and _maxSale inside condition.
_spender is the allowance key written by approve.
delegate_a is the delegatecall target address.
delegate_b is the calldata forwarded to the delegatecall.
mints_spender determines which balanceOf entry is overwritten.
mints_addedValue is scaled and written into balanceOf.
init_saleNum becomes the _saleNum limit.
init_token becomes the _minSale limit.
init_maxToken becomes the _maxSale limit.
batchSend_tos drives the distribution loop and its length.
batchSend_value is multiplied by the recipient array length.
setTradeAddress_addr is stored into tradeAddress.
ctor_supply determines the totalSupply and deployer balance.
The local total is the product that can overflow before the balance check.
Loop index i iterates the batchSend recipient array.

normalization_plan.reason: _from is only a formal argument used to select the source balance inside transferFrom and ensure.
_to is only a formal argument used as the recipient of the transferFrom balance update.
_value is only a formal argument bounding the amount moved in transferFrom.
_spender is only used as the allowance mapping key inside approve.
delegate_a exists only as the delegatecall target of delegate.
delegate_b exists only as the calldata blob forwarded by delegate.
mints_spender is only the balanceOf key written by _mints.
mints_addedValue is only the minted amount written by _mints.
init_saleNum is only stored into _saleNum by init.
init_token is only stored into _minSale by init.
init_maxToken is only stored into _maxSale by init.
batchSend_tos is only the recipient array traversed by batchSend.
batchSend_value is only the per-recipient amount consumed by batchSend.
setTradeAddress_addr is only the value assigned to tradeAddress.
ctor_supply is only the initializing supply argument of the constructor.
batchSend_total is the overflow-prone product that defines the unsafe multiplication.
batchSend_i is only the loop counter of the batchSend distribution loop.
ensure_UNI_local is only the temporary pair address computed inside ensure.
